question: What rules and numbers do the shared vehicle graphs (abilities, vehicle expressions, vehicle projectiles) hold?

sourceFacts.method: Compiled expression graphs were listed with expression-graphs/exgraph.py (format from L4016, names from L4017 and L4019) and read section by section by a delegated reader; each constant cited here was then checked at its raw offset in the resource file. Full reading: expression-graphs/findings/vehicles-common.md.

control.description: Every cited constant is a raw-offset check against the resource body. Function meanings marked inferred in the findings file are not relied on for the checked values.

points: Weapon-slot cycling: 16 small graphs (Hellfire, Stinger, Maverick, Mk 82, AIM-9X, GBU-39 and others) increment the active launcher index and wrap to 1 past the launcher count.

Smoke (`SimEx_SmokeMechanics`): each cloud applies `HideFromLockOn` for the Hide Duration tunable to entities inside, optionally with missile-jammer, laser-paint removal, cloud-volume and force-minimum-angle-damage effects; tracer-dart interaction is behind a kill switch. The smokescreen ability graph holds 6.5 and 5.0 constants; the passenger smoke launcher 21 and 2.4 (roles not established).
Flares: 400 per minute (one every 0.15 s); then `Flares_RemoveSignature` for `IsLockableTime` minus the best active lock's progress.
Radar: effective range = maximum range x max(range-increase effect, 1); a target with the jam-locking-weapon effect gets range 0; spots last one tick.
Explosives detection: detonations staggered by 10 fixed fractions of `MaxDetonationDelay`; a 0.15 constant is present.
Cluster bomb (Rockeye): rings of 1, 4 and 8 bomblets (13 in all, inferred), 2 degrees per ring, random speed 0.85 to 1.15.
Passive anti-spotting and anti-lock abilities apply their effect while active and drop when laser-painted, damaged or slowed, with a reactivation timer.

Mortar illumination descent uses 58, 70 and 80 m/s by charge; the 120 mm airburst graph holds 225; bunker buster 0.525 and 0.75; thermal smoke damage 2.5; vehicle thermal signature 0.9 (roles in the findings file, several inferred).

inference: The Rockeye bomblet count comes from loop arithmetic.
Constants listed without a role were raw-checked for value only.
unresolved: Ability cooldowns and durations are imported tunables with no value here.
State graphs return 16-output native calls, so state numbers 3, 4, 5 are unnamed.
One low-fit listing (spotted weapon fire) is probably misaligned.
The reader worked from a filtered copy of the listings for the smaller graphs.
siteImpact: None. No Analyzer data, simulation or UI change.

leads.title: Shared vehicle graphs read: smoke hides entities inside it from lock-on for a tunable duration, flares fire at 400 per minute and remove the signature for the lockable time minus lock progress, radar range is the maximum range times a range-increase effect and zero against jammed targets, and weapon-slot cycling is one shared wrap-around pattern
leads.summary: All 93 shared vehicle listings were read (the five largest in full, the rest through a copy with plain copy instructions removed). Most tuning values are imported tunables. The rules: smoke applies a hide-from-lock-on effect to entities inside it; flares fire at 400 per minute and then remove the signature for the lockable time minus lock progress; radar range scales with an effect and is zero against jammed targets; detected explosives detonate staggered over ten fractions of a maximum delay. 13 raw-offset checks matched.
leads.reopenWhen: A vehicle ability number is needed for a claim, or the vehicle tunable file is joined to these rules.
leads.statusNote: Shared vehicle graphs read at reader level; constants raw-checked for value.
